name: Multilanguage Form Display
description: Extends the node form so an editor can enter values for other languages' translatable fields inline, saving all translations from one form.
project_description:
Summary 
 
Multilanguage Form Display exists to make your translated content editing

a little easier. It provides a unified translation editing experience on a single

form.

 Please see the Documentation page for more detailed information and step-by-step configuration instructions.

 Known Issues 
 
Due to a bug in the WidgetBase class, a core patch is required to use this module.

 
Otherwise, you will get the following error:

 Warning: Illegal string offset '_original_delta' in /app/web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Field/WidgetBase.php on line 372 

 
Please refer to the relevant issue page for details:

 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/2991986 . 
 

 
The patch is located here: 

 
 https://www.drupal.org/files/issues/2019-06-18/2991986-6.patch 
 

 
Please follow these How-To install a patch instructions:

 
 https://duvien.com/blog/how-apply-patch-file-composer-based-drupal-89 
 

 Note: 
 
This module works really nicely with a multi-column layout. You can active these by using the field_layout module and picking a layout for the form. By placing the default fields in one column and the multilingual form display in a second column, you get a nice side-by-side editing experience.
